mechanism: Propylthiouracil can cause agranulocytosis and bone marrow suppression, while torsemide may increase electrolyte abnormalities and dehydration that can potentiate PTU toxicity; both drugs can affect cardiac function in hyperthyroid patients.
action: Monitor CBC regularly during concurrent use, ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte balance, and consider alternative antithyroid agents if bone marrow suppression develops.
